### (1) R-36 / Q55 — fixed and pinned (CONFIRMED)

**The code.** `growth/proposals.ts` `deadEnd` (`:631 – :641`): when the kernel will not mark the street's last vertex,
the `end` junction is popped, the way's `to` becomes a bearing, and the count goes to
`rec.intermediates['W_END_UNMARKED']`. `refused` (`:136 – :137`) now holds only kernel refusals of a step's insert other
than F-NUM's precision codes (`:723 – :724`). F-NUM's `re_propose` / `reject` stay in `rungs` (`:702`, `:713`, `:719`),
the ladder lines the Stage declares (`ladder: F-NUM ['re_propose', 'reject']`). Nothing else reports these events:
`grep` over `packages/layout/src/growth/` finds no `report.` call and no `.bug(` call. `pipeline/report.ts` writes a
`bugs` row only from a stage's `bug` call (`:291 – :294`) or a refused stage run (`stageRefused`, `:344 – :347`), and S5c returns ok on
these seeds. No reader in `packages/*/src` or `bench/src` reads S5c's `refused` (`grep '\.refused'`).

**The pin.** `packages/testkit/test/layout/growth-s5cd/intermediates.test.ts`, *S5c absorbs its own intermediates on the
registered plain seeds (census R-36)*. It runs plain 9, 17, 20 and 23 through `fixtureRun` (which throws on any S3, S4
or S5 refusal) and asserts four things:

* every S5c and rim record's `refused` is `{}`, and no batch or prune is refused;
* one `W_END_UNMARKED` per seed under `intermediates`, and its street stands (`ends` `dead`, `to` a bearing);
* at 20 and 23, F-NUM `re_propose` then `reject` `E_BELOW_MIN_EDGE` on that street's proposal;
* over the four seeds, 4 unmarked ends and 2 rejects.

The pin is green in NEAR.

### (2) N-c1-1 — pinned at two sites; `snapArm` equivalent (CONFIRMED / PLAUSIBLE)

The seat re-read the source note N-c1-1 (`checks/M0-c-05-notes.md:249`) and the inventory row (`hardening-inventory.md:1333`).
The fix shape asks for one hand case per site.

| id | mutation | target | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Z20 | `joinState`'s arms sorted in reverse (`proposals.ts:939`) | `test/growth/s5cd/` | **red**, `Tests 1 failed \| 49 passed (51)`: *joinState: the arms of the junction snapped to are sorted by compareKeys (`way:10` before `way:5`) …* |
| Z20b | `joinState`'s arms left in append order | same | **red**, the same test |
| Z21 | `pruneAndTrim`'s `setJunction` arms sorted in reverse (`prune.ts:214`) | same | **red**, `Tests 1 failed \| 50 passed (51)`: *a short dangling secondary pruned from a junction of three arms leaves its two others sorted …* |
| Z21b | `pruneAndTrim`'s arms left as filtered (no sort) | same | survives 100 / 100. **Equivalent**: every arm list enters sorted, because `newJunction`, `snapArm`, `joinState` and the prune each sort, and a filter keeps the order (N-s2c-1) |
| Z19 | `snapArm`'s arms sorted in reverse (`proposals.ts:880`) | same | survives 100 / 100 |
| Z19t | `snapArm` throws on entry (reach probe) | NEAR's 15 files | **passes 146 / 146**: no test reaches `snapArm`; the census probe counts 0 streets ending `snap` in 44 runs |
| P2 | the hit loop skips a hit at t ≥ 1 once a junction was snapped (`legality.ts:600`; the snap reaching a junction on a way) | `legality.test.ts` | **red**, `Tests 1 failed \| 31 passed (40)`: *a junction a way runs through is never snapped to …* |

**The seat's own equivalence judgement on Z19** (not the builder's label). `legal` ends a step by a snap only when
`ends === null` after the hit loop (`legality.ts:668`), and the snap sets the step's end `q` exactly to the junction
(`:581 – :583`).

* Every junction `growthArea` hands over is a T, X or Y arena vertex. Every junction S5c adds to `junctionPts` (kinds
  T and X, `proposals.ts:603`) is a point of the street it inserted: the origin T is the street's first point, an X a
  vertex laid at the crossing, an end T its last point. Each is an exact end of an indexed way segment.
* `crossParams` (`enceinte/plane.ts:97`) accepts t = 1 inclusive. So unless that segment is skipped, the step `at → q`
  hits it at t = 1. Then `act` cannot be `'cross'` (it needs `hit.t < 1`), so the step ends in a T or is rejected,
  never in a snap.
* A segment is skipped in two cases. (a) `ignored`: it passes within 1 cm of the step's start. The snap's square test
  then reads it, and the junction lies ≥ 0.65 step from the start, so the chord runs along it, under 30°, and the
  junction is refused. (b) It belongs to the proposal's own street: the square test refuses it outright.
* Therefore `snapArm` is reached only for a junction with no way segment through it, which no lawful input makes at M0.
  The executed evidence (Z19t, the 0-snap census) agrees.

Z19 is equivalent. The premise is pinned (P2 red), so a change that lets a snap reach a junction on a way turns the
premise test red before `snapArm` would need its hand case. A row left at "equivalent with its premise pinned" is the
fix shape's intent: no hand case can reach a private function that no input reaches.
